title: Praise God From Whom All Blessings Flow
altTitles: Doxology; see also 'Awake, My Soul, And With The Sun'
author: Thomas Ken (1637-1711)
credit: Thomas Ken, 1674.  Music: 'Old 100th' Genevan Psalter, attr. Louis Bourgeois, c. 1551.
firstLine: Praise God, from Whom all blessings flow;
verses: Praise God, from Whom all blessings flow;
Praise Him, all creatures here below;
Praise Him above, ye heav'nly host;
Praise Father, Son, and Holy Ghost.
